scope_rationale: Finite corpus maximal-munch tokenization was not implemented by the prior regular-language recognizer or decimal lexer; selection, rescanning and memo lifetime require separate construction.

outcomes: Derive longest-prefix and earliest-rule semantics, a quadratic rollback witness and a sound failed-configuration invariant.
Implement bounded whole-call output rollback, exact metadata/capacity failures and actual prior regex-DFA composition with explicit ownership.
Falsify independent scanner/memo defects, account for state-dependent resource costs and runtime closure, and transfer under changed input or accepting labels.

preservation: Additive required refinement; historical accepted records unchanged.
